notes: two rescripts, each with its own question and addressee: the first to «أبي الحسن», the second to «أبي الحسن» (the text glosses it «يعني علي بن محمد»; not used), so two sayings with the same head (rule 4a)
«أخيه جعفر بن عيسى» reduces to the name alone (rule 7)
«كَتَبْتُ إِلَى» makes the writer a link and the addressed Imam the last link (rule 5)
